pipelineConformance.description: Non-circular integrity check: every build emitted by the recommendation service is re-validated through the rule engine, and every referenced component id is checked against the catalog. This tests the architectural guarantee that no unvalidated build can reach a user (CP1 §3.2.4 Reliability).
